name: Bureau Works TMGMT Connector
description: A TMGMT translator plugin that submits Drupal content to the Bureau Works localization platform and pulls delivered translations back in.
project_description: Bureau Works TMGMT Connector adds Bureau Works as a translation provider to the Translation Management Tool (TMGMT). Its machine name is bureauworks_tmgmt and it registers a single TMGMT translator plugin (id 'bwx', label 'Bureau Works'). Editors submit TMGMT sources (job items) to Bureau Works from the standard Translation > Sources / Jobs UI; the plugin creates a Bureau Works project over the REST API (/api/v3), exports each job item as XLIFF, uploads it as a project resource with the configured workflows, and stores the remote project/resource UUIDs on the job item's remote mapping. Delivery is pull-based: hook_cron polls the Bureau Works API for delivered work units and queues completed job items for import, and editors can also click 'Fetch translations' on an active job. The module supports TMGMT continuous jobs, auto-saving/auto-accepting translations for configured workflow stages, optional preview URLs sent to Bureau Works, and two Views fields (BW Project Name, BW Last Workflow Delivered) on tmgmt_job_item. It requires the tmgmt and tmgmt_file modules and a Bureau Works subscription with API credentials.
